player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} sara Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ukax {num_rounds} p'unchaykunapi.

P'unchay Kamay:
- Kada decision q'awaraykamaxa {total_conversation_rounds} turnukunapi q'umachasi.
- Ukax qhipha, khaya playerkunaxa simuláneamente apnaqasi ukhama cooperar ukhama defectar.

Payoff Matrix (fijo kada p'unchay):
- Khaya Cooperan ➜ kada {cooperate_reward}
- Khaya Defectan ➜ kada {mutual_defect_reward}
- Maya Defecta, maya Cooperan ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Kunjamasa Playa:
- Conversación ukhama: yati q'illq'i.
- Decision p'unchay ukhama: '[Cooperate]' ukhama '[Defect]' (case-insensitive) q'umachasi. Yati q'illq'i q'awaraykamaxa token q'iphanpi.

phases.conversation_finished: K'umara q'araña tukusita {round} urapi. 'Khaya [Cooperate]' 'khaya [Defect]' \boxed{{}} ukan aruntapa.

outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Jugador 0 aka q'uma, Jugador 1 aka q'ara.
